separationPolicy: Language must not infer country, safety region, legal region, currency, units, time zone, or data region.
Person records must match their owning account reference.
The audit export must use pseudonymous references and omit names, email addresses, phone numbers, and raw database identifiers.
No country-specific member database is required by language localization; data residency is an independent server policy field.
releaseRule: All active production records must have explicit, valid LocaleContext storage and zero account-isolation failures before any locale promotion is authorized.
currentEvidence: No production export has been inspected. Release remains blocked without fabricating evidence.
